snippet.title: Wildfire Doubles Overnight In Canada | 12,000-Person Town Evacuated As Flames Explode | VERTEX
snippet.description:
British Columbia has declared a provincewide state of emergency as the Bald Range wildfire near Summerland nearly doubled overnight, reaching about 9,500 hectares and forcing thousands to evacuate. Officials described flames rising hundreds of feet above treetops and a fire-generated weather system producing lightning that could intensify the blaze. More than 2,000 firefighters and support personnel are deployed across the province, which recorded 70 new fires in one week and has 105 active wildfires. Summerland also declared an emergency after losing power and issuing a boil-water advisory. The crisis comes amid Canada’s wider wildfire season, with approximately four million hectares already burned.

snippet.title: Total Shutdown: Day 1 To Day 100 (Full Story)
snippet.description:
Every traffic light in the city goes dark in the same second, and you are a delivery driver stuck in the middle of a six-lane intersection. Your phone says No Service. Over the substation, black smoke. The power grid is gone. Home is two miles away, on the eleventh floor, and by midnight your faucet will cough once and go silent for good.

Day 1, the grid goes down. Day 100, you are still counting what is left. Thirty-one people stay behind in an old brick building with no water, no heat and no idea when the lights come back. The roof tank runs dry, a gang in gas masks starts counting the floors of your building, and every week the cold gets closer.

Along the way you learn why the top floors of a building lose water first, where forty or fifty gallons of clean water are already hiding in your home, why the toilet tank is safe but the bowl is not, how many drops of bleach make a gallon drinkable, why gas pumps die the minute the grid does, and the silent killer that takes more lives in a long blackout than most people expect.

One full animated survival story, about an hour long, and the total blackout happens to you.

Forty-seven gallons, thirty thirsty neighbors. Share or hide? Tell me in the comments.

snippet.title: What If the Power Grid Shut Down Worldwide?🌍⚡
snippet.description:

In this video, you’ll see the full process of building, finishing, and testing the bushcraft survival shelter on the cliff - from gathering materials to creating a comfortable and safe place to live in the wild.
